faqs.question: Will a mouse work with any laptop brand?
faqs.answer: Our mice work across brands via standard USB — check the specs on each listing for exact compatibility.

faqs.question: Will an external case fit my drive?
faqs.answer: Each case listing states the drive size and interface it supports. If you're unsure, send us your drive's size on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Will a RAM module fit my laptop?
faqs.answer: Check the type (DDR4 vs DDR5) and form factor on the listing, then send us your laptop model on WhatsApp and we'll confirm compatibility before you order.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with accessories?
faqs.answer: Mice and external cases carry a 6-month warranty; RAM and surveillance drives ship with warranty as noted on each listing.

faqs.question: What's the difference between a surveillance HDD and a normal one?
faqs.answer: Surveillance drives like WD Purple are built for continuous 24/7 recording from CCTV/NVR/DVR systems, which is a heavier sustained workload than typical desktop use.
